title: biscutella longifolia subsp. kerneri
intro: Biscutella longifolia subsp. kerneri, commonly known as Kern's biscutella, is a plant species in the family Brassicaceae, native to the Iberian Peninsula. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues and respiratory problems, due to its reported health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Kern's biscutella are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, act as an expectorant, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a potential treatment for conditions like bronchitis and pneumonia. The bioactive constituents of Biscutella longifolia subsp. kerneri include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
